Each day there are more decomposing abominations roaming the dark halls of that place. Recently, we've even encountered some making their way to the surface and frightening the locals. Or worse, attacking them!'' :''We have discovered that the increasing number of undead in the Catacombs is caused by several powerful Undead Necromancers whose tombs have been disturbed. They are now going through the Catacombs, animating every corpse they come across. Go to the Catacombs and put those [[Necromancer]]s back to rest, so we don't have to worry about walking dead in addition to [[Charr]]. Unless, of course, you're afraid of the dark..."'' {{ Offer dialog | accept = I fear nothing! They will die... again. | decline = I'm not afraid of the dark, I'm afraid of what it hides! }} ===Reward dialogue=== ; Lieutenant Langmar :''"There now, that wasn't so bad, was it?"'' ==Notes== *The Undead Necromancer just north of [[Ashford Abbey]] zone will kill the gargoyles as you approach and create minions; because of this, it is advised to trigger its spawn then go kill the other necromancers so that the minions will die on their own. You can also opt to [[spike]] the Necromancer first so that its underlings have to fend off the masterless minions. *The Undead Necromancer in the northwestern pit's room can spawn on either the left or right side of the room. *Several active quests can provide allies: ** [[A Monk's Mission]] and [[Rites of Remembrance]] will spawn allies in the area with the [[Swamp Water]]. Respectively, [[Paulus the Abbot]], a level 3 ally with skills dealing holy damage, and several [[Restless Spirit (pre-Searing)|Restless Spirit]]s, level 10 allies. ** [[The Necromancer's Novice]] will have [[Necromancer Munne]], a level 5 ally, guide you to the area before the spiders. However, you have to talk to her and this will override your secondary profession skills with necromancer skills. {{Vanguard_Quest_nav}} [[Category:Vanguard quests|Undead]]
